title: Parameter-Free Dynamic Regret under Heavy-Tailed Noise
summary: We study online convex optimization with one unbiased stochastic subgradient per round and noise having a finite $p$-th central moment, where $p\in(1,2]$ is unknown. For a bounded convex domain of diameter $D$, subgradients bounded by $G$, noise scale $σ$, and comparator path length $P_T$, let $Λ_T=1+P_T/D$. A single algorithm, using none of $G,σ,p,P_T$, attains expected dynamic regret $O_p\left(\min\{GD\sqrt{TΛ_T}+σDT^{1/p}Λ_T^{(p-1)/p},\,GDT\}\right)$ against every fixed comparator sequence.
